verdict.rationale: Kimi publishes a substantial API surface: an OpenAPI spec covering chat completions, responses, files, batches, tool search and models, plus an Admin API for members, projects, keys, billing, usage and audit logs. That covers core chat and console management. However, the probe found no public API for the Kimi assistant app itself, so UI features such as deep research, PPT assistant, memory, scheduled tasks and agent web-building have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: API coverage of assistant-app features (deep research, PPT, memory, scheduled tasks, agent/website building, plugins/skills), a documented UI-to-API parity commitment, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Kimi Admin API lets organization administrators manage members, invitations, projects, and inference API keys programmatically, and query billing, usage, and audit logs
